svg.text: One feature of the Brassicaceae LC-MS/MS data, written with the proposed terms
Feature 589 (negative mode), annotated as glucotropaeolin. Values from the S6 node table; badges name the specification requirement (MET-xx, COM-xx) that holds each term.
from the S6 node table, row 589
RT is not in the generated RDF yet (MET-15)
sio:SIO_000772 has evidence (to both evidence nodes)
lodp:anchoredToMetabolite (the claim points at the node that already exists)
The claim is its own node: it says how the feature was identified and how well. PlantMetWiki itself is not changed.
Two independent pieces of evidence (spectral library, MS2Query) support the same claim, each from its own run.
Orange terms are not in an ontology yet: these are the points for discussion.
in the data, not in the RDF yet
Source: Wolters et al. 2026, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.19391098 (S6); pilot pilots/metabolomics_overlap; specification pathway-lod/lod-pathways-community.
